artifacts.bundle_name: Pastor Rob McCoy Sermon Audio Bundle

sub_items.description: Sermon excerpt in which Pastor Rob McCoy states Charlie Kirk "was wise enough at 31 to put together [sighs] a plan for succession. It's very clear what they decided and they're implementing it now."
Slow-motion clip tracking Mikey McCoy raising phone to ear 834 milliseconds after gunshot audio.
Footage showing Mikey McCoy in background at Charlie's waiting car, still on phone.
Footage showing Mikey McCoy on phone ~1 minute 45 seconds before the gunshot.

Selfie video of unnamed camera operator recorded within approximately one minute of the shooting. Captured audio: "They just shot Charlie. They just shot Charlie. There's your shot, Charlie. He's dead. God help me."
Footage of camera operator's actions in the four minutes preceding camera takedown, sent by the operator to Candace Owens via phone.

artifacts.bundle_name: Candace Owens-Charlie Kirk British Columbia Fishing Photo

sub_items.description: Photo of Candace Owens holding a caught fish alongside Charlie Kirk (eyes closed), taken by Donald Trump Jr. or Corey Lewandowski ("Flash") during a fishing trip in British Columbia.

Audio/video clip of Charlie Kirk at a UVU event responding to a question on friendship. Captured dialogue: "If you aren't wealthy, white, and male, Charlie Kirk is not your friend." / "Find out. I'm going to find out a sign outside of a thing in an event that we just did that you're not my friend."

artifacts.bundle_name: HBO-Style Miniseries Trailer – Charlie Kirk / Israel Donors

sub_items.description: Produced trailer segment narrated by host referencing Charlie Kirk text messages, including: "Jewish donors play into all the stereotypes. I cannot and will not be bullied like this." Trailer indicates a follow-up segment about a lawyer (Josh Hammer) discussing potential defamation claims.

artifacts.bundle_name: Charlie Kirk Text Messages to Candace Owens (April 6, 2018)

sub_items.description: Read-aloud text message exchange dated April 6, 2018 containing the following attributed Kirk statements:
Read-aloud tweet by John Miller reacting to Josh Hammer's reported defamation threat: "They really trying to make us believe this is the good guy. LMAO"

Read-aloud collection of celebrity comments regarding Candace Owens quoted in connection with book promotion ("Make Him a Sandwich"). Includes comments attributed to Cardi B, Lance Bass, Ireland Baldwin, Roseanne Barr, Eminem, JoJo Siwa, Ben Shapiro, and Chrissy Teigen.
Ian Carroll comment: "Fishing takes time. You got to set the bait. It's so good to have you back, Candace."
Amanda comment: "This is sick. Thank you, Candace, for always sharing the truth. God bless you."
Kiki Mack comment: "Thank you so much for helping remove the wool from my eyes and bringing me back to church…"
Amal comment: "I hate to be morbid, but God truly saved you by removing you from DW…"
Joshua Steves comment: "Tyler Robinson appearing in court today via Zoom without having to show his face surely isn't helping any of the theories out there. It's good to have you back."
Ivana Milano comment: "Keep up the great work…"
Tim Morgan comment: "For the investigation for Charlie. We love you. God bless."
Caitlyn comment (anecdotal): cites brother HM's prior statements about dying before age 40; died at 41.
David Foster comment: "I didn't even know Charlie and I was more shook up seeing the footage than the camera guy seemed in a selfie video. He wasn't even shaking…"
Bayern comment: "Come back, Candace. Everyone needs…"

claims.label: Mikey McCoy Phone-to-Ear Timing Measured at 834 Milliseconds
claims.claim: The host says that in a slowed-down clip it is exactly 834 milliseconds from when the shot is heard until Mikey McCoy puts his phone to his ear.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain raw event-day footage with synchronized audio timestamps for independent verification of the 834ms figure; obtain Mikey McCoy's call log for 12:23 p.m. on 2025-09-10.

claims.label: Host Says Footage Shows Mikey McCoy on Phone About 1 Minute 45 Seconds Before Shot
claims.claim: The host says she and her team found what they think could be the moment, approximately 1 minute 45 seconds before the gunshot, when Mikey McCoy is on his phone.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference call log timestamps with footage timestamps to determine call duration and recipient.

claims.label: Host Says Footage Shows Mikey McCoy Still on Phone at Charlie's Waiting Car
claims.claim: The host says event-day footage shows Mikey McCoy in the background at Charlie Kirk's waiting car, still holding his phone.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify timing continuity and identify any change in phone-use posture during the post-shot interval.

claims.label: Host Says Camera Operator Recorded Selfie Video Post-Shot
claims.claim: The host says the unnamed camera operator recorded a selfie video within the first minute after the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original selfie video metadata (timestamp, device, file hash) and authenticate chain of custody.

claims.label: Camera Operator Announced Charlie Kirk Dead in Selfie Video
claims.claim: In the selfie video, the camera operator states "He's dead."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain video and assess whether any medical assessment could have supported such a declaration at that moment.

claims.label: Camera Operator Sent Pre-Takedown Footage to Candace Owens
claims.claim: The camera operator sent Candace Owens a video showing his actions during the four minutes preceding camera takedown.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original sent video and metadata to authenticate the four-minute pre-takedown window.

claims.label: Pastor Rob McCoy Announced TPUSA Succession Plan on 2025-09-14
claims.claim: Pastor Rob McCoy publicly stated, four days after Charlie Kirk's death, that Kirk had assembled a succession plan and that TPUSA was implementing it.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source of Pastor McCoy's information regarding the succession plan and the timeline of its formulation.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Texted Death-Prophecy Statements on 2018-04-06
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk texted Candace Owens on April 6, 2018 stating he "might not see this whole thing through," that he was "not sure if I will live to see the end of this revolution," and that he had dreamed about being "wiped out" since the beginning of TPUSA.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain authenticated message metadata (timestamps, device identifiers, original phone) and corroborate via independent device forensics.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Kirk Texted Her That She Was the Piece to Finish the Fight and to "Be My David"
claims.claim: Per text messages the host reads aloud and says Charlie Kirk sent her, he wrote that "you were the piece that God meant me to meet that will finish the fight" and "be my David."
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate message metadata as for C-1468.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Stated TPUSA Would Be the Death of Him
claims.claim: Host asserts Charlie Kirk told her that "Turning Point was going to be the death of him" and characterizes this as supported by the April 6, 2018 texts.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any direct verbatim text within A-1266.1 that matches the precise phrasing "Turning Point was going to be the death of him."

claims.label: Host's Trailer Presents Charlie Kirk Texts on Jewish Donor Pressure on TPUSA
claims.claim: In a trailer the host plays, Charlie Kirk text messages are presented as stating "Jewish donors play into all the stereotypes. I cannot and will not be bullied like this."
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate text message source and timestamp (referenced as having been shown in prior episode; verify against original).

claims.label: Charlie Kirk UVU Event Clip – Friendship Exchange
claims.claim: UVU event clip captures Charlie Kirk responding to a question about friendship with the line "Find out" regarding whether Kirk was the questioner's friend.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the date, venue, and full transcript of the UVU exchange.

claims.label: Candace Owens and Charlie Kirk Fished in British Columbia
claims.claim: Photo depicts Candace Owens and Charlie Kirk on a fishing trip in British Columbia; photographer described as Donald Trump Jr. or Corey Lewandowski ("Flash").
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm photograph date and photographer identity.

claims.label: Candace Owens Traveled to College Campuses with Charlie Kirk for Six Years
claims.claim: Host states she hit college campuses alongside Charlie Kirk for six years and that she does not believe any other living person has spoken at more college campuses alongside him than she has.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against TPUSA event records and tour itineraries to verify six-year span and event count.

claims.label: John Miller X Post Characterized Josh Hammer as "the Good Guy" Insincerely
claims.claim: John Miller posted: "They really trying to make us believe this is the good guy. LMAO"
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original post URL and timestamp on X.

claims.label: Josh Hammer Threatened Defamation Action
claims.claim: Trailer references Josh Hammer stating he is "talking to lawyers" and believes there is "a potentially serious case here for defamation."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any written cease-and-desist or formal litigation filing; verify Hammer's legal credentials and standing.

claims.label: Camera Operator Brought into TPUSA by Tyler Bowyer
claims.claim: Host states the camera operator was brought into TPUSA by Tyler Bowyer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA hiring/contract records for the unnamed AV company operator.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet and Sheridan Were Brought In by Tyler Bowyer
claims.claim: Host states that the people she listed for the group chat, including Andrew Kolvet and Stacy Sheridan, were brought into TPUSA by Tyler Bowyer.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via TPUSA organizational records.

claims.label: Stacy Sheridan Brought into TPUSA by Tyler Bowyer
claims.claim: Host states Stacy Sheridan was brought into TPUSA by Tyler Bowyer to handle big-donor relations.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via TPUSA organizational records.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk's Stated Final Words – Book Promotion
claims.claim: Host sarcastically attributes Kirk's last words as "Buy my book. Buy Josh Hammer's book," referencing Hammer's same-day book promotion after Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain authoritative transcript of Kirk's on-stage remarks immediately prior to being shot.

claims.label: Frank Turek's Reaction Described as Normal Post-Shot Behavior
claims.claim: Host says that, as Ian Carroll pointed out in one of his videos, Frank Turek was the only person acting right; she says the normal first reaction is to drop to the ground and get low, and that Turek then crawls back toward Charlie Kirk and tries to see him to the car.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate video evidence corroborating Turk's specific movements.

claims.label: Ian Carroll Commented on Host's Return
claims.claim: Ian Carroll commented: "Fishing takes time. You got to set the bait. It's so good to have you back, Candace."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original comment thread.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson Court Appearance via Zoom Without Face Visibility
claims.claim: Joshua Steves commenter states Tyler Robinson appeared in court via Zoom "without having to show his face."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain court appearance records and any media coverage of the Zoom appearance.

claims.label: Third-Party Viewer Perceived Camera Operator Reaction as Abnormal
claims.claim: A viewer comment the host reads, from David Foster, says he was "more shook up seeing the footage than the camera guy seemed in a selfie video" and that the camera operator "wasn't even shaking."
claims.investigative_direction: Corroborate viewer characterization against any independent frame-by-frame review of A-1262.1.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Did Not Respond to Comment Request
claims.claim: Host states she contacted both Mikey McCoy and Andrew Kolvet for statement/comment and received no response.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any written correspondence or call records from the outreach attempts.

claims.label: Host Asked for Devil's Advocate on Mikey McCoy
claims.claim: Host states she told someone to play devil's advocate for Mikey McCoy and explain how he did it so quickly; "no one could win this game."
claims.investigative_direction: Document the scenarios considered and rejected.

claims.label: Host discussed Zeb Boykin in witness / outreach context
claims.claim: The host says it is thanks to people on the internet like Sam Parker, James Lee, Ian Carroll and Zeb Boykin, among others, that a video from September 10th has gone pretty viral.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference name spelling against prior episodes and public records.

claims.label: Host referenced Scott Adams video on Kanye tweet (verbal reference)
claims.claim: Host states she will dig up a Scott Adams video about Kanye West's tweet ripping a hole through the universe.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the referenced Scott Adams video and timestamp the host mention.

claims.label: Host discussed Ryan Mata in comment / outreach thread
claims.claim: Host discusses Ryan Mata in episode comment-thread context (register anchor).
claims.investigative_direction: Identify primary artifact anchor if a dedicated clip exists in a later pass.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk's Closest Allies and the White House Moved On Quickly
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk's "quote unquote closest friends," his closest political allies and the White House all seemed ready to move on much faster than she did, and that some may have accepted his death within minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's account with the public statements and schedules of Kirk's allies and the White House in the days after 2025-09-10.
claims.transcript_snippet: his quote unquote closest friends, his closest political allies, the White House, they all seemed kind of ready to move on so much faster than I was.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Knew She Alone Would Step Up to Defend Him
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk knew she was the only person who was going to step up to defend him after he was gone, and says "that sounds crazy, but it's the truth."
claims.investigative_direction: The proof would be Kirk's own messages to the host; compare the message set read later in this episode (A-1266.1) with original device records.
claims.transcript_snippet: He also knew that I was the only person who was going to step up to defend him after he was gone.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Paid Her Flight to Wyoming for the Rogan Appearance
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk paid for her flight to Wyoming, which she had to take quickly because she was doing Joe Rogan's podcast.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the date of the Rogan recording and any travel or payment records the host holds.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie I was thinking out there and remembering paid for my flight to Wyoming. I had to get there very quickly because I was doing um Joe Rogan's podcast.

claims.label: Host Says Kanye Invited Her to a Wyoming Album Release Party
claims.claim: The host says Kanye West invited her to his album release party in Wyoming, which is why she flew there to follow the Rogan taping.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the date and location of the Wyoming album listening event and the host's attendance.
claims.transcript_snippet: because Kanye had invited me to his album release party.

claims.label: Host Says Her Last Wyoming Trip Was with Kirk for Foster Friess's Funeral
claims.claim: The host says the last time she went to Wyoming she was with Charlie Kirk, for the funeral of Foster Friess.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Foster Friess's funeral notice and attendee reports to date the host's trip with Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: the last time I went to Wyoming I was with Charlie Kirk who was the last person I visited with and it was for um ironically Foster Friess funeral

claims.label: Host Calls Foster Friess a Big-Time TPUSA Donor
claims.claim: The host describes Foster Friess as a big-time donor to Turning Point USA who she believes still is one.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA donor disclosures and press coverage for Friess family giving to Turning Point.
claims.transcript_snippet: Foster Friess funeral who was a big- time donor to Turning Point USA still is I believe

claims.label: Host Says Kanye's Album Party Venue Later Hosted Friess's Funeral
claims.claim: The host says the Wyoming venue where Kanye West held his album release party is where Foster Friess's funeral was held years later.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the venue of the album event and of the funeral service.
claims.transcript_snippet: where he held that album release party would be where years later Foster Friess would have his funeral.

claims.label: Host Says It Had Been 47 Days Since Kirk's Death
claims.claim: The host says that it had been 47 days since Charlie Kirk was executed, and calls it a public execution.
claims.investigative_direction: Count from 2025-09-10 to the episode date 2025-10-27; the figure is arithmetically consistent.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's now been 47 days since my friend Charlie Kirk was executed in front of the world because that's what it was, a public execution.

claims.label: Host Says She Expected the Inner Circle to Form a Group Chat for Answers
claims.claim: The host says she had assumed Kirk's inner circle (Tyler Bowyer, Andrew Kolvet, Stacy Sheridan) and she would be on a group chat together pursuing answers.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the named individuals whether any such group chat existed after 2025-09-10; compare with the nine-member group chat described in episode 15.
claims.transcript_snippet: We were all going to maybe be on a group chat. Me, Tyler Bowyer, Andrew Kolvet, Stacy Sheridan.

claims.label: Host Says Stacy Sheridan Held the Camera at the Air Force Two Casket Escort
claims.claim: The host says Stacy Sheridan is the person holding the camera while Charlie Kirk's casket is escorted off Air Force Two.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the casket-arrival footage and confirm who was holding the camera; check Sheridan's own account.
claims.transcript_snippet: she's the one who's holding the camera when Charlie's casket is being escorted off of Air Force 2.

claims.label: Host Calls Stacy Sheridan TPUSA's Chief Money Person
claims.claim: The host says Stacy Sheridan is essentially the chief money person at Turning Point USA, brought in to reel in the big donors.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Sheridan's TPUSA title and hire date in TPUSA staff pages and filings.
claims.transcript_snippet: She's like the chief money person essentially at Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Host Says a Source Reports Kirk's Circle Believes the Lone-Shooter Narrative
claims.claim: The host says she is told the people around Kirk believe the official narrative of a lone shooter with no one else involved.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek on-record statements from Bowyer, Kolvet and Sheridan on whether they accept the lone-shooter account.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am told that these people believe the official narrative. Lone shooter. No one else involved.

claims.label: Host Says a Source Reports TPUSA Headquarters Is at Business as Usual
claims.claim: The host says she is told that back at headquarters it is business as usual.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask former or current TPUSA staff about operations in the weeks after 2025-09-10.
claims.transcript_snippet: back at headquarters, I am told it's business as usual

claims.label: Pastor McCoy Says His Son Told Him That's Not Charlie's Plan
claims.claim: In the sermon clip played, Pastor Rob McCoy says that when he told his son he had a plan, the son answered "Dad, that's not Charlie's plan."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full recording of the sermon and confirm which son is quoted and what plan is meant.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I thought, I I got a plan for you, son. He said, "Dad, that's not Charlie's plan."

claims.label: Pastor McCoy Names His Sons' TPUSA Roles in the Sermon
claims.claim: In the sermon clip, Rob McCoy says he is looking at his son who is 24 years old, that Justin is the chief CFO, and that Mikey is the chief of staff.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against TPUSA leadership listings and filings for the McCoy sons' titles and start dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Justin's the chief CFO, chief financial officer, and Mikey's the chief of staff.

claims.label: Pastor McCoy Says Mikey Called Him the Minute Charlie Was Shot
claims.claim: In the sermon clip, Rob McCoy says that the minute Charlie was shot his son called him, said Charlie had been shot in the neck, and asked him to call every pastor and pray.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain McCoy's phone records for the call time and compare them with the host's phone-timing analysis (C-1461).
claims.transcript_snippet: the minute Charlie was shot, he called me, says, "Dad, Charlie's been shot in the neck. Please call every pastor and pray.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy Had No Blood Near Him Despite the Sermon
claims.claim: The host says Pastor McCoy's account has Mikey with blood all over him, and that Mikey did not have blood anywhere near him.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-listen to the sermon to settle whether McCoy meant Mikey or Charlie; compare to event footage of Mikey's clothing.
claims.transcript_snippet: But the bigger thing is that he says Mikey had blood all over him. Except Mikey did not have blood anywhere near him.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy Was Behind the Tent When Charlie Was Shot
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy was behind the tent when Charlie got shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Map Mikey McCoy's position from stage and crowd footage and the UVU site plan.
claims.transcript_snippet: Because Mikey was behind the tent when Charlie got shot

claims.label: Host Says Rob McCoy Said He Was Watching and Asks What He Watched
claims.claim: The host says McCoy's account stops with "I was watching," and asks what exactly was being watched.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the sermon audio wording (the clip reads "I'm watching" in the transcript) and ask McCoy what he was watching.
claims.transcript_snippet: But he stops himself. He says, "I was watching." Watching what exactly. What were you watching?

claims.label: Host Says the 834 Milliseconds Left No Time to Dial
claims.claim: The host says that because Mikey McCoy's phone reaches his ear 834 milliseconds after the shot there was no dialing, and a call cannot be dialed and raised to the ear in that time.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the raw frame-level footage with audio sync and test whether a speed-dial is possible in that interval.
claims.transcript_snippet: there's no dialing. Mikey didn't have time to dial.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey Was on a Call Within Two and a Half Seconds on the Other Side of the Tent
claims.claim: The host says that Mikey McCoy is next seen in just under two and a half seconds, on the other side of the tent, on a phone call.
